result.summary: Found 2 major issues: malformed delivery time text and truncated restaurant name in the restaurant listings.

issues.description: Delivery time under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' displays as '25-350delivery' with improper formatting and spacing, making it unclear whether this should be '25-35 min delivery' or another value
issues.suggestion: Fix the text formatting to properly display the delivery time range with appropriate spacing and unit (e.g., '25-35 min delivery')

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated and the full name is not visible
issues.suggestion: Ensure the full restaurant name is visible by adjusting text wrapping, card width, or font size to accommodate the complete name
